title: lannea schweinfurthii var. stuhlmannii
intro: Lannea schweinfurthii var. stuhlmannii, commonly known as African cherry, is a plant species within the Anacardiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in African folk medicine for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents present in Lannea schweinfurthii var. stuhlmannii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-hyperlipidemic, and anti-diabetic effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant have been attributed to its ability to modulate inflammation, improve lipid profiles, and enhance glucose metabolism.
